frozen: 2026-10-24, after stages A-C and before generating V4/V5

Standard.note: stage A winner; gates apply to this rule

Robust.note: registered stage C winner; reduces Q-underestimation error but costs up to ~6% at correct/high Q on development data; reported, not gated

common.fallback: lambda=1, no VQ near dead traces or with <2 neighbours

stage_outcomes.A: lambda 0.5/16 kept (dev overall ratio 0.972 vs v1, weak 1.009).
stage_outcomes.B: abandoned: interference + multiple dominated samples carry only 1-7% of V3 error; primary-dominated samples carry 80-97% and FullCalRefit has the same error there, so the residual is wavelet/model error, not shrinkage.
stage_outcomes.C: trade-off: every Q-uncertainty variant tried (two-sided, one-sided, coherence-weighted) helps Q-30% and costs accuracy at correct/high Q; Robust kept as an option only. Variants after the interim check were added post hoc and are disclosed.

sealed_validation.V4: new four-layer variant: opposite dip, faults at traces 35 (-20 ms) and 75 (+16 ms), weak reflector 4 pinching out to the left by trace 25, true Q [38 70 60 140]; noise seeds 2026102441/2026102442.
sealed_validation.V5: new complex geology (seed 2026102451, calibration 2026102452, observation seeds 2026102461/2026102462), faults at 1500/2550 m, channel, wedge thinning to the right-to-left tip at 1300 m, gas lens; independent calibration with the frozen code.
sealed_validation.Q: -30/-10/0/+10/+30% relative to true (V4) or calibrated (V5) Q.
